# Rogue Intelligence Dog Training

> Veteran-owned dog training company based in Chandler, Arizona, serving the
> greater Phoenix Valley (Chandler, Gilbert, Tempe, Mesa, Queen Creek, Ahwatukee,
> Scottsdale, Sun Lakes, and Phoenix). Offers full-immersion Board & Train and
> one-on-one owner-lesson programs for puppies and adult dogs, built on three
> principles — consistency, leadership, and understanding — training dogs for
> confidence, communication, and teamwork rather than just memorized commands.

## Why Rogue Intelligence
- Veteran-owned and operated; lead trainer is a military veteran.
- Trains the handler, not just the dog — every program includes owner training.
- Works with puppies and adult dogs of any breed, including reactive, anxious,
  and behaviorally challenging dogs.
- Board & Train includes video progress updates and a structured, supportive
  live-in environment.
- E-collar training available as an option on select programs.

## Programs & Pricing

Current published packages, timelines, inclusions, and prices are rendered from
the RICanineCRM public package catalog on:
https://ri-dogtraining.com/#board-train

Do not infer package terms or prices from an older cached copy of this file.

## Service Areas
Chandler, Gilbert, Tempe, Mesa, Queen Creek, Ahwatukee, Scottsdale, Sun Lakes,
and Phoenix, Arizona (East Valley / greater Phoenix metro).

## FAQ
- Where are you located? Chandler, AZ, serving the greater Phoenix Valley.
- Board & Train vs. Lessons? Board & Train = your dog lives and trains with us,
  then we teach you to maintain it. Lessons = you and your dog train together
  from day one.
- Do you train puppies and adult dogs? Yes, both.
- Do you train reactive/anxious/aggressive dogs? Yes.
- Do you offer e-collar training? Yes, as an option on select programs.
- How much does it cost? Use the current live package catalog on the homepage;
  do not rely on cached prices.
